definitions.explanation: the transfer of private enterprises or assets to government ownership

examples.japanese: {銀行|ぎんこう}の{国有化|こくゆうか}が{検討|けんとう}された。
{石油|せきゆ}{産業|さんぎょう}を{国有化|こくゆうか}する。
{経済|けいざい}{危機|きき}で{国有化|こくゆうか}が{進|すす}んだ。
examples.english: Nationalization advanced during the economic crisis.

notes:
{国有化|こくゆうか} is the opposite of {民営化|みんえいか} (privatization).

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {国|こく} (country, nation)
- {有|ゆう} (have, possess)
- {化|か} (-ization, change into)

USAGE:
- {国有化|こくゆうか}する (to nationalize - suru verb)
- {国有化|こくゆうか}される (to be nationalized)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銀行|ぎんこう}の{国有化|こくゆうか} (nationalization of banks)
- {土地|とち}の{国有化|こくゆうか} (nationalization of land)
- {一時|いちじ}{国有化|こくゆうか} (temporary nationalization)

RELATED TERMS:
- {民営化|みんえいか} (privatization - opposite)
- {国有|こくゆう} (state-owned)
- {国営|こくえい} (state-operated)
